payout_quote: Each time a Potential New Client becomes a new Acorns User using your personal invitation code or referral link that you shared with them during the Promotional Period in accordance with the eligibility criteria below, you will receive a $5 investment of Reward Shares in your Acorns Invest Account.
steps: Be an Acorns User with an open and active Acorns Invest Account in Good Standing.
Share your personal invitation code or referral link (generated in the Acorns app/site) with friends - only contact people with their prior express consent.
Your friend signs up for a first-time Acorns subscription using your link/code, sets up an Acorns User Account, and opens an Acorns Invest Account.
Your friend completes an initial investment of $5 or more into their Acorns Invest Account from a linked bank account within 14 days after the end of the Promotional Period.
Your $5 investment of Reward Shares is typically deposited into your Acorns Invest Account within 30-45 days of your friend's initial deposit settling.
catches: The $5 is NOT cash - it is a $5 investment of ETF Reward Shares in your portfolio; 'There is no option for a cash alternative to this promotion.'
Friend must be completely new to Acorns (never an Acorns User or started sign-up) and must invest $5+ from a linked bank account within 14 days after the promo period.
Being a Referring Client requires an Acorns Invest account in Good Standing, which sits on a paid Acorns plan (starting around $3/mo) - factor that against the $5 reward.
Acorns can change terms or terminate the promotion at any time, with or without notice; rewards are at Acorns' sole discretion and can be withheld/clawed back for fraud or ineligibility.
You may only contact people about the referral program with their prior express written consent - no spam or mass marketing (posting links without consent is a violation and forfeits rewards).
Investing involves risk including loss of principal; the $5 is invested in ETFs, not held as cash.
biggest_catch: The $5 per referral is invested ETF shares with no cash alternative - and you must keep an Acorns Invest account (paid plan) in good standing to qualify as a referrer.
eligibility: Acorns User with an open and active Acorns Invest Account in Good Standing; US legal residents/citizens 18+.
timing: Reward Shares typically deposited within 30-45 days of the referred friend's initial deposit settling into their Acorns Invest Account.
